construction.name: prism_envelope_antiprism_ring_slots
construction.proof:
WHOLE PRISM ENVELOPE TO ANTIPRISM RING/SLOT COMPOSITION

Take a complete native source of canonical regular p-prisms of height h, with centers c_i and actual rational proper frames R_i. Retain every full source owner and source provenance. The target is canonical q-antiprism, full height H, whose two horizontal rings together project to a regular 2q-gon of radius R_q.

Let L=lcm(p,2q). The source facet normal angles form a p-grid and the projected target vertex angles a 2q-grid. Their differences form an L-grid. Choose the ONE canonical phase theta=arg(n_0)-arg(v_0)+pi/L (mod 2pi/L), so every source facet lies midway between two nearest points of the difference grid. Then max over all source normals/target vertices of cos angular difference is cos(pi/L). This proves the concentric whole projected target lies in alpha times the source base when alpha >= R_q*cos(pi/L)/a_p, where a_p is the source apothem. No optimized angle or frame approximation is inferred from a metric search.

For k complete target children per source, require alpha*h >= k*H. Put child (i,j) at alpha*c_i + R_i((j-(k-1)/2)*H*e3), j=0..k-1, with frame R_i Q_theta. Every child lies inside the same uniformly scaled complete parent; siblings have disjoint open axial intervals, and different parents inherit the original complete parent separation. The inverse decoder is (parent index i, axial slot j). Both axial signs of an arbitrary frame are respected by R_i e3; there is no common-axis hypothesis.

The source inequality proves this at the exact forced phase. A native implementation will choose a declared rational quaternion lift close to that single phase and recheck ALL actual source facet/target vertex inequalities with outward intervals, selecting a rational alpha no smaller than that actual containment requirement and k*H/h. All centers and all common cube wall costs are evaluated from the transformed actual child vertices. A common center/host dilation restores binary64 rounding; both inherited cross-parent and sibling separators and actual final native checks are mandatory.

First screen only actual retained/current prism parents with count n and k*n<=100 against current full public/private/pending AP cube gates. Preserve known-nominal certificate classification. The screen is only a proposal; full canonical containment and physical native decoding are required before claiming a gain. No antiprism record follows merely from a circular radius or volume inequality.

construction.name: complete_rectangular_prism_column_return
construction.proof:
COMPLETE RECTANGULAR COLUMN RETURN
15 October 2026

The preceding octagonal face-contact return produced 63 complete owners
in nine square-footprint columns, with seven owners per column. Preserve
that unequal-phase return separately. The following regular-phase product
is a second complete geometry with the same ideal enclosure, and transfers
the physical mechanism to every prism height.

Let R be the fixed proper frame that aligns an actual prism side-face
normal with the x axis. For regular 8- and 12-prisms this is the specified
rotation pi/k from their canonical vertex-to-x frame. For the other prism
families retain the canonical frame. No frame is selected by a metric
search. Let l_j <= (Rv)_j <= u_j be rigorous bounds for every vertex v of
the complete canonical prism. Put m_j=(u_j+l_j)/2 and choose the rational
cell width W_j strictly greater than u_j-l_j. Convexity places the whole
owner R P - m strictly inside its axis-parallel cell of widths W_j.

For positive integers A,B,C, put complete owners at
  c(i,j,k)=((i-(A-1)/2)W_x,(j-(B-1)/2)W_y,(k-(C-1)/2)W_z)-m
for 0<=i<A, 0<=j<B, 0<=k<C. Distinct index triples differ in a coordinate,
so the corresponding open cell interiors are disjoint and their complete
owners are strictly separated in that coordinate. Every owner lies in the
box A W_x by B W_y by C W_z, hence in a cube of side
  S=max(A W_x,B W_y,C W_z).
The enclosing cube has the common center 0. Deleting any explicit subset
of whole owners preserves both properties and retains all boundary costs.

For ideal prism widths w_x,w_y,w_z the same construction has nominal
capacity floor(S/w_x)floor(S/w_y)floor(S/w_z). Its only changes occur at
the explicit events S=m w_j. Taking the first event with capacity>=N is
an exact finite consequence of the product construction, not a packing
optimality claim. The witness generator uses outward rational W_j and
checks the complete native geometry afterward.

This is a classical rectangular product packing. PingYou Ltd supplies
the new finite assemblies and complete certificates that improve the
pinned current prism records; no invention of Cartesian-product packing,
of the regular polygon, or of the infinite contact lattices is claimed.
These assemblies use no published finite donor packing. Current record
authors remain in the separately retained baseline witnesses.

The unequal-phase octagonal source return and this equal-phase grid must
not be identified as the same marked continuation state. Both survive in
the record tree. No density or global optimality statement follows here.

canonical_inclusion.scope: The exact geometric phase follows the regular p/2q difference-grid law. The stored quaternion is one declared rational approximation to that phase; ALL actual rounded target frames and two extreme slot endpoints are independently interval-contained in the same alpha-scaled source. No correctly-rounded transcendental or exact algebraic phase is claimed.

construction.inverse_decoder: Undo stored center rounding error, divide by rho, add midpoint, subtract R_source times local slot offset, and divide by alpha. Parent/slot labels recover the complete original source and each child; source quaternion and exact phase product are retained separately from rounded native target quaternion.

contribution.method:
This is an explicit replacement archive for 23 previously submitted cases, adding zero new distinct campaign cases. SUPERSESSIONS.json identifies the prior issue, archive, native hash and certified scale for each case. Ten replacements improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; thirteen improve the complete native certificate without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

These complete constructions combine forced-phase prism-to-antiprism ring/slot inclusion, literal whole-owner prefixes, prism column and height/collar transfers, and retained whole-row returns. Every source has a full physical decoder with actual owner centers and frames. Certificate improvements arise from these physical operations; their narrower numerical scope is retained explicitly.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparison review, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves the complete source chain, original donor attribution, reviewed intermediate packings and explicit supersession identities. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimum is claimed. Please treat these as stronger replacements, not as 23 additional distinct cases.
